fact: At a working session on Friday 27 September 2024, Xgest was reported as used by 728 school establishments across Gabon, notably for managing marks and publishing end-of-year and examination results, and as managing more than 327,300 learners in 8,840 class divisions; it belongs to the startup Groupe Tereza, the State being its client until then, and the company offered to open 38 per cent of its capital to the State. The level of the establishments is not stated.
title: Gabon : L'application Xgest bientôt utilisée dans l'enseignement supérieur ?
